title: Choose the visual world for Phone Health
question: The roll assigned the Inspection Tag. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Inspection Tag
options.lineage: lockout/tagout and equipment inspection tags hung on machines that run unattended
options.thesis: The server phone wears its own inspection tag: the whole screen IS the tag, and the tag's stock colour is the verdict, readable from across the room.
options.viewport: Full-bleed tag in the verdict colour (green INSPECTED · SERVING, safety-yellow CHECK, red DO NOT LEAVE UNATTENDED). Grommet hole top-centre; the worst finding set at headliner size under it; a 7-day punch strip (7 rows x 96 quarter-hour punches, hollow = logger asleep, red = service down) with a 'now' marker; services and a tear-off stub with the last-inspected time at the foot. Bottom bar: Status / Readings / History / Tests.
options.risk: Industrial-maintenance ephemera is sysadmin-adjacent, not every hobbyist's world; set timidly it reads as a green card with a hole in it.

raised.raise: Billing: severity is carried by type size alone. The worst problem headlines full-width; healthy checks pack into a small justified block at the tag's foot.
One unbroken timeline: the 7-day punch strip is the page's single continuous line, with a chase marker on the current quarter-hour.
Named phases, never colour alone: temperature and throttling read as named bands (COOL / WARM / HOT / THROTTLING) printed beside every colour.
One statement per viewport: the first screen makes exactly one claim, the verdict; everything else sits below the stub.

options.label: Barograph Drum
options.lineage: clockwork barographs and chart recorders that ink a week onto a rotating drum while nobody watches
options.thesis: Unattended time is the product, so the app is a recording instrument: a pen trace of heat, charge and uptime wrapped around a 7-day drum.
options.viewport: The week's temperature trace across a gridded chart sheet, today's pen position live at the right edge, verdict engraved on the instrument plate above.
options.risk: Closest to the charts-and-cards dashboard this category already ships; the most familiar card here.

options.label: Cathode Numeral Stack
options.lineage: nixie-tube counters on a bench at 2am
options.thesis: Every possible state hangs as an unlit ghost; the current one is struck forward in cathode orange.
options.viewport: Thermal state NONE to SHUTDOWN stacked as ghosts with the live one struck; battery temperature as a glowing numeral stack.
options.case: Homelab and maker audiences love nixie clocks (holds audience); a strict two-hue orange world cannot carry red/amber/green severity, so it loses on clarity.
options.risk: Sits in the near-black-plus-one-glow cluster most AI UIs land in.

options.label: Starship Wall Panel
options.thesis: The phone as a ship's engineering station: elbows frame banks of systems, red alert is a first-class state.
options.viewport: A lilac elbow sweeps down the left edge, pill segments per system, the verdict as a full-width alert bar.
options.case: Self-hosters already theme dashboards like this (holds audience); numeric codes as labels and pastel semantics blur status (loses clarity).
options.risk: Pop-culture pastiche that dates fast and borrows someone else's identity.

options.label: Festival Lineup Poster
materials: one condensed face at eight sizes
options.case: Clear hierarchy, but self-hosters don't see their server in a gig bill.
options.kept: Billing: severity carried by type size.

options.label: Drum Machine Step Row
options.case: Playful, but steps and tempo are not how anyone reads uptime.
options.kept: One unbroken timeline with a chase marker for now.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.case: Atmosphere without a task; hides numbers.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.case: Spectacle over scanning; wrong for a glance at a server.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Material 3 device-care dashboard (Samsung Device care, Google's battery health screens), executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A big circular health score, a row of tonal cards per subsystem, bottom navigation bar.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the phone's own Device care screen by design.
